hook: 'up to' is doing a lot of work
hook_say: 'Up to' is doing a lot of work this Black Friday. I counted how many products are really at the number on the banner.
sub: i counted every in-stock product at each store

brands.say: rothy's says up to 40% off everything. I counted: 70 of 643 products are at 40% or more, and the typical pair is about 25 off. If you want the real 40, it's the almond loafer, the square ballerina and the après clog. Go straight to those.

jet set candy, up to 50% off. 74 of 1,920 products are at 50% or more. Most of the store is 25, and a chunk is 40. The half-off ones are a handful of charms, like the passport and the sriracha bottle, so check the tag before you fall for one.

bk beauty calls it their biggest sale of the year, up to 40% off. 2 of 78 products are at 40% or more. Two. A bundle and one concealer brush. The rest is mostly 20, which is fine, just don't go in expecting 40.

heaven mayhem, up to 60% off sitewide. 24 of 184 products are at 60% or more, and most of the site is 30. The 60 is real on some earrings and the chunky bangles, so if you like those, good. Everything is final sale.
organic basics, up to 60% off sitewide. 273 of 1,950 products are at 60% or more. That's about one in seven. Not one pair of underwear is at 60. It's some tees and bras, shorts, track sets and swim.
now two that do the opposite. alexandra miro says 20 to 50% off, and 63 of 126 products are at 50% or more. Half the store. It's resort dresses and swim, all final sale, so know your size.
and daze denim. The banner only says 25% off, and 78 of 156 products are at 50% or more. Jeans that were $118 are $41. That's the one I'd open first.

close_say: So before you scroll a whole sale, find the handful that's really at the big number, or skip it. Which banner got you this week?
caption: Six sales where the banner number covers a sliver of the store, and two that give more than they promise. Counts are from each store's full catalog on Nov 26-27. Which 'up to' got you this year? Commissionable links in bio.
pinned_comment: How I counted: every in-stock product on each site, its current price vs its own crossed-out price, read Nov 26-27. Extra discounts that only show up at checkout are not in these counts.
recheck: Open each homepage on Sat and confirm the banner still says the same claim (Rothy's 'up to 40% off everything', Jet Set Candy 'up to 50% off', BK Beauty 'up to 40% off', Heaven Mayhem 'up to 60% off sitewide', Organic Basics 'up to 60% off sitewide', Intentionally Blank 'up to 75% off sitewide'). I could not re-read them today: every homepage except Mac Duggal returned a bot check.
Alexandra Miro: '20–50% off' comes from the sheet row only; the stored homepage text shows no number. Confirm on the site or say 'sale' without a number.

Daze Denim: claim is '25% off' (homepage 'BLACK FRIDAY EVENT 25% OFF'). 70 of its 156 products show no markdown in the catalog, so the 25% is probably taken at checkout; the 78 at 50%+ are catalog markdowns.
Rothy's catalog lists some styles twice (an all-colors page plus one page per color) and includes kids and men's; the 70 of 643 counts every listing. Many of the 70 are kids' loafers and clogs.
Jet Set Candy menu also showed 'up to 40% off' and 'up to 25% off solid gold'; the top banner read 'BLK FRI Up to 50% OFF'. 587 of 1,920 are at 40%+.
BK Beauty third tile (16-piece brush set) is 35% off, not 40: only 2 products are at 40%.
Intentionally Blank skates are low on sizes (Rink 5 of 40 variants in stock, Trippy 3 of 7).
Organic Basics: sweaters are shot on a male model; I used the flat shot. Check it ships from a US $ store at checkout.
All sales end Dec 1 (BK Beauty Dec 2) per the sheet.
dropped: BaubleBar: claim is '30% off sitewide', applied outside the catalog; modest claim, not an 'up to' story
Mac Duggal: live homepage says '25% off sitewide, price as marked' but 2,705 of 3,457 catalog products show no markdown, so the count for its 'sale dresses up to 60% off' (44 of 3,457) is not safe
Petal & Pup: 30% with code BF30 at checkout; ends Nov 29
Hudson Grace: says 20% off everything and 93% of the store is marked; they deliver
Parachute Home: 'up to 70% off' is scoped to archive and 'up to 40% off select styles'; bundle discounts are not in the catalog
Society Social: 20% sitewide with code EVERYTHING20; checkout discount
Jenni Kayne: 'up to 60% off' but only 24 of 1,168 products show any markdown in the catalog; sale prices likely applied elsewhere, cannot count
Marine Layer: claim is 25% off and 53% of the store is marked; modest claim
Social Threads: code at checkout (CYBER25 / BLACKFRIDAY30)
Favorite Daughter: claim is 25% off; modest, not an 'up to'
DL1961, Nisolo, Hommey, Harper Wilde, Brooklinen, Sterling Forever: sitewide discount taken at checkout, catalog can't show the true top number
Canopy: catalog full of subscriptions and test products; count not clean
Knix: 'up to 50% off everything' and 157 of 694 are at 50%+; about 1 in 4, not a sliver
M.M.LaFleur, Hanky Panky: top number covers 11-17% and the rest of the sale is deep; not fair to call out
Vicci Eyewear, Noble: also generous (98 of 148 at 70%+; 82 of 157 at 50%+) but less known than the two closers
end_q: which store should i count next?
